metadata.title: Admission controls of kubernetes-air-gapped-ai-agent v1.8.0: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.2.0, one run
metadata.remarks: Observations of Kyverno's PolicyReports and of the API server's dry run are C2P's, unchanged; each names its check, and so its engine. Admission test observations and every finding are written by scripts/evidence.py; c2p/ holds C2P's own results for both engines and its posture.

results.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.2.0: the admission controls of kubernetes-air-gapped-ai-agent v1.8.0
results.description: C2P 1.0.0: its kyverno-cel plugin on Kyverno's PolicyReports, its vap plugin on the API server's answers to a server-side dry run of each running pod, aggregated into one assessment results.

findings.title: si-7: satisfied
findings.description: Kyverno and the API server's dry run reported every running pod passing model-volumes, verify-models, and every test that proves it did what the mapping says (volume-elsewhere, model-unsigned, model-stranger, model-signed).

findings.title: sr-4: satisfied
findings.description: Kyverno reported every running pod passing verify-models, and every test that proves it did what the mapping says (model-nobom, model-signed).

findings.title: sr-11: satisfied
findings.description: Kyverno and the API server's dry run reported every running pod passing carried-images, verify-models, models-need-kyverno, and every test that proves it did what the mapping says (image-not-carried, volume-not-carried, model-unsigned, model-stranger, kyverno-away, model-signed).

findings.title: cm-7.5: satisfied
findings.description: Kyverno and the API server's dry run reported every running pod passing carried-images, and every test that proves it did what the mapping says (image-by-tag, image-not-carried, model-signed).
